otter_stick.name: OTTER STICK
otter_stick.desc: EDVIN'S CARVED DRIFTWOOD STICK. FACE WATER AND PRESS SPACE TO CALL YOUR OTTER.

seal_flute.name: SEAL FLUTE
seal_flute.desc: A BONE FLUTE. A SEAL CARRIES YOU THROUGH ICY WATER WHERE THE OTTER WON'T GO.

axe.name: AXE
axe.desc: TOVE'S OLD AXE. CLEARS FALLEN TREES THAT BLOCK THE WAY.

pickaxe.name: PICKAXE
pickaxe.desc: OLD BJORN'S PICK, FROM COPPERHAVN. BREAKS CRACKED ROCKS.

lantern.name: LANTERN
lantern.desc: OLE'S OLD LANTERN. LIGHTS UP DARK CAVES.

cellar_key.name: CELLAR KEY
cellar_key.desc: OPENS THE CELLAR UNDER THE KEELVIK INN.

bird_bell.name: BIRD BELL
bird_bell.desc: RING IT AT A TALL PERCH: THE GREAT ERNE LIFTS YOU BY ITS FEET ACROSS A CHASM.

whale_horn.name: WHALE HORN
whale_horn.desc: A HORN OF WHALEBONE. SWIM OUT TO WHERE THE WATER TURNS DEEP AND DARK: A WHALE WILL CARRY YOU ACROSS THE OPEN OCEAN.

dragon_band.name: DRAGON BAND
dragon_band.desc: A RED AND GOLD ARMBAND. PRESS F OUTDOORS TO CALL THE DRAGON. IT FLIES YOU TO ANY LANDING PLACE YOU HAVE WALKED TO, ONCE AN HOUR.

running_shoes.name: RUNNING SHOES
running_shoes.desc: LIGHT, SPRINGY SHOES FROM AN OLD COURIER. YOU WALK A LITTLE FASTER, FOR GOOD.

ferry_pass.name: FERRY PASS
ferry_pass.desc: CAPTAIN NILS'S PASS. ONE FERRY CROSSING A DAY BETWEEN KEELVIK AND COPPERHAVN.

walking_stick.name: WALKING STICK
walking_stick.desc: A SOLID STICK. PRESS R TO WEAR IT OR PUT IT AWAY.

lamp_oil.name: LAMP OIL
lamp_oil.desc: A SMALL TIN OF OIL FOR LAMPS.

smoked_fish.name: SMOKED FISH
smoked_fish.desc: A GIFT FROM LIV. YOUR STOMACH APPROVES.

sea_chart.name: SEA CHART
sea_chart.desc: A CHART OF THE HOME WATERS, FROM JOAR'S STALL.

dragon_scale.name: DRAGON SCALE
dragon_scale.desc: A SCALE THE SIZE OF A PLATE, FROM THE FAR EAST. THE SELLER SWEARS IT'S REAL.

ship_plans.name: SHIP PLANS
ship_plans.desc: FULL PLANS FOR EIRIK'S BIG SHIP.

ring.name: SILVER RING
ring.desc: A WOMAN'S RING, FOUND IN THE REEDS. SOMEONE MUST MISS IT.

knife.name: OLD KNIFE
knife.desc: A FISHING KNIFE, BURIED IN THE SAND. THE HANDLE SAYS "LIV".

tern_plank.name: TERN PLANK
tern_plank.desc: DRIFTWOOD WITH A TERN CARVED INTO IT.

compass.name: ARVID'S COMPASS
compass.desc: SIGVE'S BROTHER'S COMPASS. IT ALWAYS POINTS HOME.

amber_heart.name: AMBER HEART
amber_heart.desc: A FIST-SIZED PIECE OF AMBER, WARM TO THE TOUCH. ONLY ONE CAN HAVE IT.

float.name: GLASS FLOAT
float.desc: A FISHING FLOAT OF GREEN GLASS.

moonstone.name: MOONSTONE
moonstone.desc: SELMA'S GIFT. IT GLOWS FAINTLY AT NIGHT.

sea_glass.name: SEA GLASS
sea_glass.desc: BLUE SEA GLASS FROM THE FYRHOLM TIDE POOLS.

ship_bell.name: SHIP'S BELL
ship_bell.desc: A GREEN BRONZE BELL FROM A SHIP THAT SANK LONG AGO. IT WAS IN THE INN CELLAR.

whale_tooth.name: WHALE TOOTH
whale_tooth.desc: A WHALE'S TOOTH, SMOOTH AS SOAP. FROM THE BEACH AT SKARVSKER.

frost_crystal.name: FROST CRYSTAL
frost_crystal.desc: A CRYSTAL OF ICE THAT NEVER MELTS, FROM THE FJELLTARN SUMMIT.

jade_figure.name: JADE DRAGON
jade_figure.desc: A LITTLE DRAGON CARVED IN JADE, FOUND IN THE MEADOWS BEYOND THE OCEAN.

old_chart.name: HALFWAY CHART
old_chart.desc: A SAILOR'S CHART OF THE OPEN OCEAN, HALF WASHED AWAY. FROM THE HALFWAY ROCK.

do: MY RING! I LOST IT BY THE RIVER WEEKS AGO.
TAKE THIS KEY. THE CELLAR HAS BEEN SHUT SINCE OLD BJORN WENT NORTH. MAYBE HE LEFT SOMETHING USEFUL.
IS THAT A FOX? KEEP IT AWAY FROM MY HENS!
AN OWL INDOORS... MY MOTHER SAID THAT BRINGS GOOD LUCK.
YOU'RE PRACTICALLY A REGULAR NOW. HAVE A LOAF, ON THE HOUSE.
THE CELLAR DOOR IS AT THE BACK. MIND THE STAIRS.
STILL NO SIGN OF MY RING. I WAS CUTTING REEDS ON THE SOUTH BANK OF THE LAUVA WHEN I LOST IT.
STEW'S ON. THE WIND'S OFF THE SEA TONIGHT.
WELCOME TO THE KEELVIK INN. WARM STEW, COLD WIND.
IF YOU WANDER UP THE RIVER, KEEP AN EYE OUT FOR A SILVER RING. I LOST MINE.
HEARD YOU STRUCK IT RICH. I'VE GOT SOMETHING NEW: EIRIK'S FULL SHIP PLANS. PRICEY, MIND.
HALVARD'S GOODS. EVERYTHING A COAST-WALKER NEEDS.
THE FULL PLANS! WITH THESE SHE'LL SAIL ONE DAY. I'LL SEND WORD WHEN SHE'S READY.
FOLLOWING THE PLANS TO THE LETTER. PATIENCE.
WHEN I WAS A BOY, A COURIER RAN FROM KEELVIK TO LAUVDAL IN NO TIME AT ALL.
WHEN HE RETIRED HE HID HIS SHOES IN THE WOODS, BY THE FLOWER FIELD EAST OF LAUVDAL. NOBODY EVER FOUND THEM.
A SHIP THAT SIZE NEEDS PROPER PLANS. HALVARD MIGHT GET SOME, BUT NOT CHEAP.
THAT HULL IN THE DRY DOCK? MY LIFE'S WORK. SHE'LL CROSS THE VIDSEA ONE DAY.
MY GRANDMOTHER'S KNIFE! WHERE DID YOU DIG THAT UP?
TAKE MY LUCKY HOOK. FAIR TRADE.
THE TERN DRIFTWOOD? IT WASHED UP BY MY DOOR. HERE, TAKE IT TO HIM.
YOU KEEP COMING BACK. I LIKE THAT. A SMOKED FISH FOR THE ROAD.
YOUR FOX IS STARING AT MY BUCKET. FINE, ONE SPRAT.
THE NETS CAN WAIT TILL MORNING.
THE NORTH CURRENT IS COLD ENOUGH TO STOP AN OTTER. SEALS DON'T MIND IT.
AND MY GRANDMOTHER'S KNIFE IS STILL OUT THERE IN THE SAND SOMEWHERE.
MORNING! I'M LIV. I FISH OFF THIS PIER EVERY DAY, RAIN OR SHINE.
I LOST MY GRANDMOTHER'S KNIFE ON THE BEACH SOUTH OF HERE. SAND EATS EVERYTHING.
SHALL I ROW YOU OVER TO FYRHOLM?
THE AMBER WENT TO THE FOREST, I HEAR. WELL, THE WOODS NEED LIGHT TOO.
IS THAT... AN AMBER HEART? MY FATHER SAID ONE COULD WAKE THE OLD BEACON ON FYRHOLM.
GIVE THE AMBER HEART TO OLE? YOU CAN ONLY GIVE IT ONCE.
THE BEACON ON FYRHOLM IS SHINING AGAIN! ASK ME ANY TIME AND I'LL ROW YOU OVER.
HOW'S THE LANTERN? IT LIT MY WAY FOR FORTY YEARS.
TAKE MY OLD LANTERN. YOU'LL NEED IT MORE THAN ME.
HALVARD SELLS LAMP OIL IN KEELVIK. JUST A FEW COINS.
I'M OLE. I KEEP THE LIGHT ON SULE NESS.
I'M OUT OF LAMP OIL, AND MY KNEES WON'T TAKE ME TO TOWN. COULD YOU BRING ME SOME?
THE OLD PATH TO MOSSHOLT IS OPEN. WEST FROM THE MOONLIT GROVE.
SO THE LIGHTHOUSE GOT IT. THE SEA AND THE FOREST ARE OLD FRIENDS, YOU KNOW.
AN AMBER HEART... THE OLD LINDEN AT MOSSHOLT HAS BEEN WAITING FOR ONE.
GIVE THE AMBER HEART TO TOVE? YOU CAN ONLY GIVE IT ONCE.
LISTEN... THE THICKET WEST OF THE GROVE IS PARTING. MOSSHOLT WELCOMES YOU.
MY OLD AXE IS STILL STUCK IN A STUMP NORTH OF THE RIVER. TAKE THE PATH OVER THE LITTLE BRIDGE.
THE STORM BROUGHT TREES DOWN ACROSS THE PATH TO THE MOONLIT GROVE, SOUTH OF HERE. YOUR AXE WILL CLEAR THEM.
OLD EDVIN KEEPS OTTERS BY THE POND IN THE GROVE. HE COULD USE A VISIT.
THEY SAY A HEART OF AMBER SLEEPS UNDER SULE NESS. IF YOU FIND IT, THINK OF THE FOREST.
I'M TOVE. I LOOK AFTER THESE WOODS.
I LEFT MY OLD AXE IN A STUMP NORTH OF THE RIVER, OVER THE LITTLE BRIDGE. TAKE IT, IF YOU CAN USE IT.
HOW'S MY LITTLE FOX? THEY CAN SMELL A COIN THROUGH A FOOT OF SAND.
HOW'S MY LITTLE OWL? THEY SEE PATHS THE REST OF US WALK RIGHT PAST.
I'M HEDDA. I NURSE ORPHANED ANIMALS. THESE TWO ARE READY FOR A HOME.
TAKE ONE WITH YOU? YOU CAN ONLY CHOOSE ONE.
TAKE THE FOX? IT WILL BE YOUR COMPANION FOR GOOD.
SHE'S CURIOUS AND HAS A NOSE FOR BURIED THINGS. PRESS C TO LET HER HIDE OR FOLLOW.
TAKE THE OWL? IT WILL BE YOUR COMPANION FOR GOOD.
HE NOTICES HIDDEN WAYS. PRESS C TO LET HIM HIDE OR FOLLOW.
TAKE YOUR TIME. THEY'RE NOT GOING ANYWHERE.
AN OWL! THE NIGHT'S OWN EYES. HE LIKES YOU.
YOU CAME BACK UNDER THE MOON. TAKE THIS MOONSTONE.
AT DAWN THE SEA PULLS BACK BELOW SULE NESS. A SANDBAR APPEARS FOR AN HOUR OR THREE.
SHH... I ONLY COME HERE WHEN THE MOON IS UP. I'M SELMA.
THE STONES REMEMBER EVERY NIGHT THEY'VE SEEN.
HELLO, CARTOGRAPHER. I'M SIGVE. I WALK THE COAST LOOKING FOR MY BROTHER'S BOAT, THE LITTLE TERN.
SHE WENT DOWN IN A STORM LAST WINTER. I'LL REST AT THE KEELVIK INN TONIGHT.
I NEED SOME AIR. FIND ME ON SULE NESS, WHERE YOU CAN SEE THE OPEN SEA.
A FISHER HERE, LIV, SAW DRIFTWOOD WITH A TERN CARVED ON IT. COULD YOU ASK HER FOR ME?
I'VE DECIDED TO STAY IN KEELVIK. EIRIK NEEDS HANDS FOR HIS BIG SHIP.
TAKE ARVID'S COMPASS. IT ALWAYS FOUND ITS WAY HOME. AND THIS, FOR YOUR TROUBLE.
PLANING OAK ALL DAY. ARVID WOULD HAVE LAUGHED AT MY BLISTERS.
AMBROSE, COLLECTOR OF CURIOSITIES. I PAY HANDSOMELY FOR THE RIGHT THINGS.
THE DRAGON SCALE CAME ON A SHIP FROM THE FAR EAST, LONG AGO. NO SHIP HAS GONE BACK SINCE. PRICED LIKE A HOUSE, I KNOW.
FEATHERS, CURIOS AND MOON TEA. THE NIGHT MARKET ONLY OPENS AFTER DARK.
CHARTS OF EVERY SHORE I'VE SAILED. CHEAP, AS THE SEA IS FREE.
THE TIDE POOLS ON THE WEST SHORE HOLD SEA GLASS. COLLECTORS LOVE IT.
WELCOME TO FYRHOLM! OLE'S MY BROTHER. YOU WOKE OUR OLD BEACON.
THE PUFFINS NEST ON THE NORTH CLIFFS. MIND YOUR FEET.
FOUND THIS POUCH IN A BURROW. THE PUFFINS DON'T NEED COINS.
I'VE COUNTED PUFFINS HERE FOR THIRTY YEARS. TWO HUNDRED AND TWELVE TODAY.
I CARVED THIS FOR YOU, FROM A FALLEN LINDEN BRANCH.
WELCOME TO MOSSHOLT. FEW OUTSIDERS EVER FIND US.
TOVE SAYS YOU BROUGHT THE AMBER. THE OLD LINDEN HASN'T HUMMED LIKE THIS IN YEARS.
IS THAT BREAD? TRADE YOU! I FOUND THESE BY THE STREAM.
THE LINDEN SANG LAST NIGHT! GRANDPA ARNE SAYS IT'S BECAUSE OF THE AMBER.
OH! A VISITOR. NOBODY COMES THROUGH THE WOODS SINCE THE STORM BROUGHT THE TREES DOWN.
I'M EDVIN. I'VE KEPT OTTERS IN THIS POND FOR FIFTY YEARS. THAT ONE HAS BEEN WATCHING YOU.
TAKE MY OTTER STICK. FACE ANY WATER AND PRESS SPACE, AND SHE'LL CARRY YOU.
THE SEA SOUTH OF SULE NESS LEADS TO COPPERHAVN. MINERS, AND A MUSEUM. GO AND SEE.
A WHALE HORN! MY OTTER IS JEALOUS. SHE'LL GET OVER IT.
THE OTTERS SAY THE SEA IS CALM TODAY. THEY ARE USUALLY RIGHT.
YOU SWAM HERE? WITH AN OTTER? WELL, I'VE SEEN STRANGER THINGS IN THE MINE.
I'M GERDA. MY BROTHER BJORN LEFT HIS PICK WITH ME BEFORE HE WENT NORTH. HE'D WANT IT USED.
THERE'S A CRACKED ROCK ON THE PATH UP THE COPPER HILL. TRY IT THERE FIRST.
BJORN ALWAYS SAID THE CAVE UNDER SULE NESS RINGS LIKE A BELL WHEN THE WIND BLOWS.
THE COPPER MINE CLOSED YEARS AGO. NOW WE MOSTLY DIG UP STORIES.
CAPTAIN NILS. MY FERRY RUNS BETWEEN COPPERHAVN AND KEELVIK: ONE DAY HERE, THE NEXT DAY THERE.
ANYONE WHO SWIMS HERE WITH AN OTTER DESERVES A PASS. ONE CROSSING A DAY, MIND.
FROM THE TOP OF THE COPPER HILL YOU CAN SEE THE SNOW IN THE FAR NORTH. THERE'S A TELESCOPE UP THERE.
I WANT TO BE A MINER. OR A CARTOGRAPHER. OR A WHALE.
YOU CAME OVER THE CHASM? ON THE ERNE'S FEET? YOU'RE EITHER BRAVE OR SILLY.
I'M INGA. I KEEP THE SEALS. THE FJORD WOULD FREEZE AN OTTER'S WHISKERS, BUT SEALS LOVE IT.
TAKE THIS FLUTE. PLAY IT IN THE COLD WATER AND A SEAL WILL CARRY YOU.
FOLLOW THE FJORD NORTH AND EAST. AT SKARVSKER THE WHALES COME IN TO SING.
THE FJORD RUNS SOUTH TO THE RIMESTREAM, AND FROM THERE TO KEELVIK. A SEAL CAN TAKE YOU HOME.
THERE'S A TELESCOPE ON THE SUMMIT. ON CLEAR DAYS YOU CAN SEE ALL THE WAY TO THE OTHER SIDE OF THE WORLD.
WELCOME TO FJELLTARN. THE TARN HASN'T THAWED IN A HUNDRED YEARS. WE SKATE TO WORK.
A SEAL BROUGHT YOU? THEN THE SEA ALREADY KNOWS YOU.
I'M HALLA. I SING WITH THE WHALES. THEY TOLD ME SOMEONE WOULD COME LOOKING FOR THE OTHER SIDE.
EAST OF KEELVIK THE WATER TURNS DEEP AND DARK. SWIM OUT THERE AND BLOW THE HORN.
NOBODY FROM HERE HAS SEEN THE FAR SIDE. THEY SAY THE LANTERNS THERE NEVER GO OUT.
LISTEN... THAT LOW HUM IS THE WHALES. THEY'RE TALKING ABOUT YOU.
THE DRAGON SHRINE IS UP ON BRANDFELL, EAST OF THE JADE RIVER. THERE'S NO BRIDGE. THERE NEVER WAS.
A WHALE! NOBODY HAS COME FROM THE WEST IN A HUNDRED YEARS. WELCOME TO WHITBORG!
WE THOUGHT THE WEST WAS JUST A STORY. YOUR MAP SAYS OTHERWISE.
THE OLD WAY UP BRANDFELL IS BLOCKED BY A FALLEN TREE, A CRACKED ROCK, AND A CHASM. PILGRIMS USED TO TURN BACK.
I MAKE THE LANTERNS. THEY NEVER GO OUT, BECAUSE I NEVER STOP MAKING THEM.
YOU CROSSED A CHASM, A RIVER WITH NO BRIDGE, AND A WHOLE OCEAN TO STAND HERE.
THE DRAGON HAS BEEN WAITING FOR SOMEONE WHO WALKS THE WHOLE WORLD. WEAR THIS.
IT WILL ONLY LAND WHERE YOU HAVE STOOD YOURSELF: TOWNS, AND THE OPEN CLEARINGS. AND IT NEEDS AN HOUR'S REST.
THE DRAGON SLEEPS IN THE CLOUDS ABOVE BRANDFELL. IT DREAMS OF MAPS.

chests.msg: OLE'S RAINY-DAY MONEY? HE WON'T MIND.
A NOTE INSIDE: "FOR WHOEVER IS CURIOUS ENOUGH TO FIND THESE. RUN WELL." - THE OLD COURIER
FEATHERS AS LONG AS YOUR ARM ARE TIED TO THE BELL. SOMETHING ENORMOUS ANSWERS TO IT.
THE SEA ONLY LETS YOU HERE AT DAWN.
WHO SHOULD HAVE IT? THE LIGHTHOUSE KEEPER, OR THE FOREST CARETAKER?
A PILGRIM'S OFFERING, LEFT FOR WHOEVER MADE IT UP HERE.

lines: KEELVIK. BOATS HAVE BEEN BUILT HERE FOR AGES.
SULE NESS LIGHTHOUSE. MIND THE LEDGES ON THE WAY DOWN.
THE OLD WATCH ON ERNE CLIFF.
FROM HERE THEY SAY YOU COULD SEE ALL OF RAVENMARK.
IT SHINES AGAIN, THANKS TO THE AMBER HEART.
ITS LEAVES HUM WHEN THE WIND IS RIGHT.
A NOTE: "OFF NORTH. LEFT MY PICK WITH MY SISTER GERDA IN COPPERHAVN, ACROSS THE WATER TO THE SOUTH.
THE CRACKED ROCK ON SULE NESS HIDES A CAVE. DON'T GO IN WITHOUT A LIGHT. - BJORN"
ONE DAY HERE, THE NEXT DAY THERE. PASSES FROM CAPTAIN NILS.
COPPERHAVN. THE MINE IS CLOSED. THE MUSEUM IS OPEN.
ONE DAY HERE, THE NEXT DAY THERE. PASSES FROM CAPTAIN NILS.

warps.locked: NOBODY HOME. THE DOOR IS LOCKED.
THE CELLAR DOOR IS LOCKED. MARIT MUST HAVE THE KEY.
GERDA'S HOUSE. IT SMELLS OF COPPER POLISH AND COFFEE.

texts.intro: WELCOME TO KEELVIK, CARTOGRAPHER. TALK TO PEOPLE AND EXPLORE. PRESS H FOR HELP.
texts.no_otter: THE WATER IS TOO DEEP TO WADE INTO. IF ONLY SOMETHING COULD CARRY YOU.
texts.ocean_deep: THE OPEN OCEAN. WAVES TALLER THAN HOUSES, WATER BLACK AND DEEP. NOTHING YOU HAVE WILL SWIM OUT THERE.
texts.whale_on: YOU BLOW THE WHALE HORN. A WHALE RISES BENEATH YOU!
texts.fallen_tree: A FALLEN TREE BLOCKS THE PATH. AN AXE WOULD CLEAR IT.
texts.fallen_tree_cut: YOU CHOP THROUGH THE TRUNK AND ROLL THE LOGS ASIDE. THE PATH IS CLEAR.
texts.edge_closed: THE WAY ON IS TOO WILD TO CROSS.
texts.dragon_rest: THE DRAGON IS STILL RESTING. IT WILL ANSWER AGAIN IN %d MINUTES.
texts.dragon_none: THE DRAGON HAS NOWHERE ELSE TO TAKE YOU YET. WALK TO NEW PLACES FIRST.
texts.dragon_call: YOU RAISE THE DRAGON BAND. FAR AWAY, SOMETHING LONG AND RED UNCOILS.
texts.telescope: AN OLD BRASS TELESCOPE ON A STAND.
texts.otter_cold: THE OTTER SHIVERS AND TURNS BACK. THIS WATER IS TOO COLD.
texts.seal_on: YOU PLAY THE SEAL FLUTE. A SEAL TAKES OVER IN THE COLD WATER.
texts.frozen: THE WATER IS FROZEN. YOU CAN WALK ON THE ICE.
texts.reef: THE REEF IS TOO ROUGH TO SWIM THROUGH.
texts.shallows: TOO SHALLOW AND ROCKY TO SWIM. MAYBE THE TIDE WILL PULL BACK.
texts.sapling: A YOUNG TREE HAS GROWN RIGHT IN THE PATH. AN AXE WOULD CLEAR IT.
texts.sapling_cut: YOU SWING THE AXE. THE PATH IS CLEAR.
texts.cracked_rock: A CRACKED ROCK. A PICKAXE COULD BREAK IT.
texts.thicket: A WALL OF THORNS. IT FEELS LIKE IT'S GUARDING SOMETHING.
texts.dark: IT'S PITCH DARK. YOU NEED A LIGHT TO GO ON.
texts.perch: A TALL PERCH STREAKED WITH WHITE. SOMETHING BIG ROOSTS HERE. A BIRD BELL MIGHT CALL IT.
texts.perch_ring: YOU RING THE BIRD BELL. THE GREAT ERNE SWOOPS DOWN!
texts.fox_sniff: YOUR FOX SNIFFS THE GROUND. SOMETHING IS BURIED NEARBY.
texts.owl_spot: YOUR OWL HOOTS. IT SPOTTED A HIDDEN WAY THROUGH!
texts.nothing_to_sell: NOTHING I COLLECT, I'M AFRAID. I'LL BE AROUND... NOW AND THEN.
texts.new_game: START A NEW GAME? YOUR CURRENT SAVE WILL BE ERASED.
texts.whale_far: THE WHALE SURGES AHEAD. THE COAST BEHIND YOU SHRINKS TO A LINE.
texts.ferry_no_pass: A DECKHAND: "PASSENGERS NEED A PASS FROM CAPTAIN NILS. HE LIVES IN COPPERHAVN, ACROSS THE WATER."
texts.ferry_used: THE FERRY HAS MADE ITS CROSSING FOR TODAY. IT SAILS AGAIN TOMORROW.
texts.ferry_today: TODAY THE FERRY IS AT %s. TOMORROW IT SAILS TO %s, AND THEN BACK AGAIN, DAY AFTER DAY.
texts.museum_intro: WELCOME TO THE COPPERHAVN MUSEUM. I'M AGNES, THE CURATOR. WE COLLECT THE UNUSUAL.
texts.museum_lend: WOULD YOU LEND THE MUSEUM YOUR %s? (AMBROSE THE COLLECTOR WOULD PAY YOU FOR IT, MIND.)
texts.museum_thanks: WONDERFUL! I'LL PUT IT ON DISPLAY RIGHT AWAY.
texts.museum_count: THE MUSEUM NOW HAS %d OF %d EXHIBITS. THE EMPTY PLAQUES SAY WHAT WE'RE STILL LOOKING FOR.
texts.museum_full: EVERY PEDESTAL IS FULL. THIS IS THE FINEST LITTLE MUSEUM ON THE COAST, THANKS TO YOU.
texts.museum_nothing: NOTHING NEW TODAY? THE EMPTY PLAQUES SAY WHAT WE'RE STILL LOOKING FOR.
texts.map_ocean: THE EASTERN OCEAN. NO CHART GOES FURTHER. THE WATER IS TOO DEEP FOR ANCHORS, AND ON CLEAR NIGHTS, FAR OUT, SAILORS SWEAR THEY SEE LANTERNS FLOATING ON THE HORIZON.
texts.map_ocean_known: THE EASTERN OCEAN. A WHALE KNOWS THE WAY ACROSS.

exhibits.where: FROM DAMHOLM, AN ISLET YOU CAN ONLY WALK TO OVER THE WINTER ICE.
exhibits.hint: SOMETHING OLD AND SILVER, FROM AN ISLAND YOU CAN ONLY WALK TO IN WINTER.

exhibits.where: FROM AN ISLET OFF THE KEELVIK COAST.
exhibits.hint: A BALL OF GREEN GLASS THAT ONCE HELD UP A FISHING NET, FROM AN ISLET OFF KEELVIK.

exhibits.where: A GIFT FROM SELMA OF THE MOONLIT GROVE.
exhibits.hint: A STONE THAT GLOWS UNDER THE MOON. ASK THE ONE WHO ONLY COMES OUT AT NIGHT.

exhibits.where: FROM THE CELLAR OF THE KEELVIK INN.
exhibits.hint: A SHIP'S BELL. INNS KEEP STRANGE THINGS IN THEIR CELLARS.

exhibits.where: ARVID'S COMPASS, GIVEN BY HIS BROTHER SIGVE.
exhibits.hint: A COMPASS THAT ALWAYS POINTS HOME. A TRAVELLER LOOKING FOR HIS BROTHER'S BOAT HAS ONE.

exhibits.where: BOUGHT AT THE KEELVIK NIGHT MARKET, FOR A FORTUNE.
exhibits.hint: A DRAGON'S SCALE. THE NIGHT MARKET IN KEELVIK SELLS ONE, FOR A FORTUNE.

exhibits.where: FROM THE TOP OF THE FJELLTARN SUMMIT.
exhibits.hint: ICE THAT NEVER MELTS, FROM THE HIGHEST POINT IN THE NORTH.

exhibits.where: FROM THE BEACH AT SKARVSKER, WHERE THE WHALES SING.
exhibits.hint: A WHALE'S TOOTH, FROM THE BAY WHERE THE WHALES SING.

exhibits.where: FROM THE HALFWAY ROCK, IN THE MIDDLE OF THE EASTERN OCEAN.
exhibits.hint: A CHART OF THE OPEN OCEAN. ONLY A WHALE COULD TAKE YOU WHERE IT WAS LOST.

exhibits.where: FROM THE JADE MEADOWS, ON THE FAR SIDE OF THE OCEAN.
exhibits.hint: SOMETHING CARVED IN JADE, FROM BEYOND THE OCEAN.

telescopes.caption: FAR TO THE EAST, BEYOND THE OPEN OCEAN: A HARBOUR FULL OF RED LANTERNS. NO MAP SHOWS IT.
FAR TO THE NORTH: A VILLAGE ON A FROZEN LAKE, UNDER WHITE MOUNTAINS. HOW WOULD YOU EVER GET THERE?
FAR AWAY TO THE EAST, ACROSS THE OCEAN: A TEMPLE ON A MOUNTAIN. SOMETHING LONG AND RED IS COILED AROUND IT.
